systems.owner: Direction régionale de l'État civil, des Migrations et des Réfugiés de Diffa, with UNICEF support
systems.tiers: four communes of Diffa region computerised between July 2023 and July 2026, with four administrateurs délégués, four departmental civil-status directors and nine civil-status agents trained on the digital tools

note: Diffa's regional civil-status directorate reports four communes computerised for civil registration (no total given) and staff trained; it states computerisation, not a connection at the commune offices, so no fact is taken.
